snippet.title: NOMIA Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
NOMIA is an isometric tactics roguelike that joins grid-based strategy with deep deckbuilding mechanics, expressed through a fantasy tale of purpose and perseverance. Set up combos with your ever-reliable Actions, or execute masterstrokes by drafting and drawing the right Gambits. Confront the past to sustain the present. Two heroes, two hands; no one should die the same way twice. 

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3608900/NOMIA/
You can also play on Itch! https://magnesiumninja.itch.io/nomia

Music by Will Goss: https://willgoss.com/
